## Howe Sound's vascular plant diversity

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plants <- read.csv("tabular_data/Howe_Sound_vascular_plant_records_consolidated_2024-11-labels.csv")
```
Over one thousand vascular plant species are known to occur within the Átl’ḵa7tsem/Howe Sound Biosphere, represented
by `r nrow(plants)` occurrence records. This diverse flora spans nine biogeoclimatic units, from lowland coastal
western hemlock forests and associated woodland communities to high elevation subalpine and alpine plant communities.

```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("scripts/Vascular_BEC_map_mapbox.R")
speciesMap
```

Explore the region's flora by selecting a biogeoclimatic unit, here or on the map:

```{r, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
# The units of each zone as chips, coloured as on the map and named in full on hover - each selects its unit, as a
# click on the map does, and the selected one is marked - see howe-becPane.vue
zones <- list("Coastal Western Hemlock" = c("CWHxm1", "CWHdm", "CWHvm1", "CWHvm2", "CWHds1", "CWHms1"),
              "Mountain Hemlock" = c("MHmm1", "MHmm2"),
              "Coastal Mountain-heather Alpine" = c("CMAunp"))
chip <- function (unit) {
  colour <- palette$col[palette$cat == unit]
  sprintf('<a class="howe-bec-chip" href="#pane:Vascular_BEC&region:%s" style="--bec-colour: %s" title="%s" @class="howe-bec-chip-selected:@{selected.%s}">%s</a>',
          unit, colour, becLabels[[unit]], unit, unit)
}
rows <- vapply(names(zones), function (zone) {
  sprintf('<div class="howe-bec-zone"><span class="howe-bec-zone-name">%s</span><span class="howe-bec-chips">%s</span></div>',
          zone, paste(vapply(zones[[zone]], chip, character(1)), collapse = ""))
}, character(1))
# Written as a raw block, which pandoc passes through as it is rather than reading the bindings @{...} as citations
cat('```{=html}\n<div class="howe-bec-zones">', paste(rows, collapse = ""), '</div>\n```\n', sep = "")
```
